title: An RGBA accepted candidate carrying a suggested palette
why: `PLTE` is optional-and-ignored on colour type 6 for the same reason it is on type 2 — it quantises nothing and indexes nothing. The tree otherwise only ever pairs `PLTE` with an indexed image or a truecolour one, which leaves 'reject `PLTE` unless colour type is 2 or 3' passing every case while refusing this legal file.
